motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses the frame: mantis, fly, wrap, box or camera; never a second where only the mouth moves; wide gestures, changing shot size
scene_lock: from 7.4 the box fills half the frame; no shot wider than the box
character: a praying mantis, green-brown, huge amber eyes, spined raptorial arms
cast: one fat fly with a straw mic, huge at the lens, never speaking, flies off at the end. The female, open from 9.2: bigger than him, a RED HEADSCARF WITH WHITE POLKA DOTS tied under her chin, same scarf on the label pictogram; she simply sits on the box
props: one box: taped, slit, empty, shut from inside; ONE sheet of bubble wrap, tape, a letterless label, its pictogram wearing the same red polka-dot headscarf
environment: a gravel doorstep in an empty yard
lighting: hard cyan rim left, warm amber kick right, deep shadows, high contrast
